import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/project/src'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from eywa.offline import Campaign
from fuzz_value import ktest
def enc(v, w): return v.to_bytes(w, 'little')
N = 3000
types = [{"name": "N8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8}, {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"}]
modules = [{"name": "app", "params": [["p", "N8"]], "result": ["o", "B"], "requires": None}]
pipes = []
for i in range(N):
    modules.append({"name": "f%d" % i, "params": [["q", "N8"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
                    "requires": ["lt", ["var", "q"], ["const", "N8", 200]]})
    if i == 0:
        pipes.append({"target": "app", "filter": "f0", "bind": {"q": "p"}})
    else:
        pipes.append({"target": "f%d" % (i - 1), "filter": "f%d" % i, "bind": {"q": "q"}})
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": [], "pipes": pipes,
            "entries": ["app"], "machine": None, "runs": []}
camp = Campaign({k: (v if k != 'runs' else []) for k, v in campaign.items()})
camp.certificate()
plan = camp.plans[0]
by_path = {tuple(p): t for t, p, w in plan.slots}
result_tag = [t for t, p, w in plan.slots if p == ['o']][0]
runs = []
for value, flag in [(5, 0), (250, 1)]:
    objects = [(by_path[('p',)], enc(value, 1)), (result_tag, enc(1, 1)),
               (plan.flag, enc(flag, 1))]
    runs.append({"entry": "app", "ktest": ktest(objects)})
campaign['runs'] = runs
sys.stderr.write('chain depth %d\n' % N)
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(campaign))
PYEOF
